payload.reason: The evidence indicates that categories exist across languages and cultures, suggesting that languages share categories based on common cognitive processes.

claims.text: Categories such as animal or furniture are fundamental cognitive building blocks that exist across cultures, allowing efficient representation of the world.
Language plays a crucial role in acquiring the meaning of abstract categories, indicating that categories are influenced by linguistic structures.
The study presents a model that learns categories and features from natural language text across diverse languages, supporting the idea of shared categories.
